source.why: Same crashnt-4.7 tree whose prebuilt 6.15.4 kernel an independent tester confirmed fixes the HDMI modeset black screen on a CUH-12xx (aday1/ps4-hdmi-blackscreen@58ce86b). The ps4_bridge ICC in-queue delays are already removed and 1080p60 is PREFERRED in this tree.

toolchain.note: Upstream README builds with clang/LLVM and -march=btver2 for the kernel; btver2 is exactly Jaguar.
